Verified Agency

Estimated reading: 2 minutes 845 views

Verified Estate Agencies

Becoming a verified agency on PropertyList.es offers significant benefits for agents and agencies, enhancing your professional network and boosting your agency’s credibility. When agents fill out the necessary information, they receive a “Verified Check Mark.” This mark indicates that they are a registered company in their respective area.


Benefits of Becoming a Verified Agency:

  1. Professional Recognition: The “Verified Check Mark” indicates that your agency is legitimate and recognised within the professional community.
  2. Check Mark on Properties: Your properties will also display a check mark on the property page, indicating their verified status.
  3. Duplicate Properties: Your duplicate listings will be prioritised over a non Verified Agency’s listing.
  4. Verification Bonus: Upon verification, agencies will be awarded 20 Credits (equivalent to €20) for use on the platform!

Steps to Become Verified:

  1. Add your company SL number
  2. Provide your website
  3. Link your social media account
  4. Connect your Google Business account.

Each “Verified Check Mark” will link to your Google Reviews.

By becoming a verified agency on PropertyList, you enhance your professional presence, connect with like-minded professionals, and build a reputation of trust and reliability within the industry.

Verify Your Agency Now

If you have any questions or need further assistance in the verification process, please reach out to our support team. We’re here to help you succeed!
